mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This appears to be a bowl of muesli or oatmeal-style cereal with milk, made primarily from rolled oats and mixed seeds. It generally has a moderate glycemic impact, but for someone with diabetes, blood sugar levels may be better supported by choosing an unsweetened, high-fiber version with whole grain oats and no added sugar.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A small bowl of oat-based breakfast cereal that appears to contain rolled oats, seeds, and milk. The meal is predominantly whole grain and fiber-containing, which may slow glucose absorption compared with refined breakfast cereals.
